responsibility: Defines the RTL operand predicates used by the MicroBlaze machine description to recognize target-specific operand forms during instruction matching and expansion. These predicates distinguish arithmetic immediates, constants, register-or-zero operands, call targets, move sources, PIC/PLT-sensitive symbolic operands, comparisons, and other admissible RTL shapes, encoding MicroBlaze-specific legality checks such as TLS and position-independent addressing restrictions.
